title: The Arrogance of the Gatekeeper
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the gatekeeper fell, a stronger aura descended from the distance. That aura was vast as an abyss, carrying a terrifying pressure, as if an ancient beast stirring from slumber was slowly opening its eyes——in the next chapter, Chen Ji will face the true trial.

text.content: Chen Ji stopped before the jade steps of the Divine Temple, the echo of that voice still reverberating in his ears. The gatekeeper's arrogance was seared into his Mental Sea like a brand. The laws of the heavenly realm? Ants? A faint smile played at the corner of his lips. Had it been months ago, he might have endured. But now, everything had changed——the fragmented Tianji Record had been largely restored, and Chen Ji was no longer the helpless fool who had been trampled upon. On both sides of the jade steps, strict guards stood in formation, golden-armored warriors with electric gazes. Halt, traveler! A majestic voice resonated from within the temple, followed by a figure emerging from the void, surrounded by pale golden law energy——this was the gatekeeper. His face was hidden within the radiant light, with only those cold, contemptuous eyes revealing his disdain for insignificant beings.

dialogue.content: What do you mean by this? Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his voice calm without a trace of fluctuation. The gatekeeper sneered, and within the golden aura, a hint of mockery surfaced: I am commanded by the heavenly realm to guard this place. How can you simply walk in? Rules are rules——if you want to pass through this gate, pay the toll first. The resources of the heavenly realm are not something common mortals like you can covet. His gaze swept over Chen Ji, full of disdain: That aura about you... is rather interesting. Unfortunately, ants are still ants. No matter how they struggle, they cannot escape the palm of the Buddha.

text.content: Toll? Chen Ji's brow rose slightly, as if he had heard the most ridiculous joke. His gaze fell upon the gatekeeper, his eyes flashing with brilliance. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, countless visions flickering past like a carousel——the gatekeeper's cultivation, divine powers, magical artifacts, and... the greed and fear hidden beneath that golden aura. Dare to be insolent before me! The gatekeeper roared in anger, and the law energy around him suddenly erupted, an invisible pressure crushing down on Chen Ji like a mountain. Do you know what great crime it is to insult the heavenly gatekeeper? His voice was ice-cold: Today, I shall teach you the true meaning of insignificance! Above the jade steps, the skies darkened, and golden law energy transformed into countless chains, sweeping toward Chen Ji. The onlookers changed color——that was a sealing technique unique to the heavenly realm. Once bound, even those with cultivation reaching the heavens would be subdued.

dialogue.content: Ants? Chen Ji laughed lightly, that laughter sounding particularly突兀 on the wind-swept jade steps. The heavenly gatekeeper is nothing more than this. His right hand slowly rose, and within his palm, a wisp of chaotic energy began to gather. The gatekeeper's pupils contracted sharply. That energy, though subtle, gave him a fatal sense of terror——it was a power that transcended the laws of the heavenly realm, the aura of... the Quasi-Dao Realm! This is impossible! The gatekeeper exclaimed, all arrogance vanished from his face, replaced by disbelief and fear: You are merely an ant who ascended from the lower realm. How could you possess such power? Chen Ji stepped forward, the chaotic energy surging violently: Who told you that I am an ant?

choice.prompt: The gatekeeper was terrified, yet still attempted to maintain the dignity of the heavenly realm, trying to overwhelm Chen Ji with his status. How will you respond?

choices.description: Crush with absolute strength, humiliating the gatekeeper before everyone, utterly destroying his face.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation +10, the gatekeeper's face utterly destroyed
choices.risk_hint: May attract the attention of stronger beings
choices.process_label: 你决定以最直接的方式，让他知晓何为真正的力量

text.content: Chen Ji did not waste words. The chaotic energy in his palm transformed into a sky-covering giant palm, slamming down fiercely at the gatekeeper. The gatekeeper let out a miserable shriek. The golden aura around him shattered instantly, that arrogant face crushed into dust by the giant palm. Heavenly dignity? Chen Ji looked down from above, his voice cold as freezing ice: In my eyes, it is nothing but a joke. Above the jade steps, a deathly silence prevailed. Everyone stood frozen in fear.

dialogue.content: I will remember you. The gatekeeper lay in a pool of blood, his voice hoarse yet still carrying venomous hatred: You wait... the heavenly realm will not forgive you... Chen Ji looked down at him, a faint indifferent arc curving at the corner of his mouth: Then let the heavenly realm come. He turned around, standing with hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping across everyone present: Who else wishes to collect my toll? No one answered. Even breathing was done carefully. Afraid to disturb this demon.

choices.description: Temporarily suppress your aura, retreating to advance, secretly noting this debt for future settlement.
choices.visible_reward: Hide your true strength, not revealing your trump cards
choices.process_label: 你决定先忍下这口气，不为一时之气暴露全部实力

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, his heart calculating silently. The information from the Tianji Record told him that the gatekeeper before him was merely the outermost piece on the heavenly realm's chessboard. The truly terrifying existence had not yet appeared. If he revealed all his strength now, he would only be beating the grass and startling the snake. He suppressed his aura, and a fitting expression of fear appeared on his face: Since such are the rules, then I shall comply with your wishes. Upon seeing this, the gatekeeper's face resumed its arrogant expression: He took a storage ring from his sleeve and tossed it at Chen Ji's feet: This is your toll——nine-tenths of your entire fortune lies within.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji bent down to pick up the storage ring, his movements so humble as to be pitiful. However, the moment he bent down, the corner of his lips curled into an almost imperceptible cold smile. Noted. He silently recited in his heart: Heavenly realm gatekeeper, extorting toll fees. The moment I step through that gate, that is when I settle accounts. The gatekeeper, proud and complacent, waved his hand: Get lost. I shall spare your life today. His back disappeared beyond the jade steps, yet the brief cold glint that flickered in Chen Ji's eyes went unnoticed by all.

choices.description: Without striking, merely use momentum and pressure to force the gatekeeper to surrender without battle, gaining maximum profit with minimum cost.
choices.process_label: 你决定以气势碾压，不战而屈人之兵

text.content: Chen Ji didn't strike. He simply stood there quietly. Yet in that instant, an invisible pressure radiated from his body, like a primordial beast opening its sleeping eyes. The gatekeeper's face turned ashen; though invisible, the pressure pressed against him as tangibly as solid matter, causing his knees to bend involuntarily. He... Heaven's Dao Laws? His voice trembled, eyes filled with terror: This is impossible, you're clearly just... Chen Ji took a step forward, the pressure intensifying sharply. The gatekeeper's knees buckled, and he actually knelt directly on the ground.

dialogue.content: I did nothing. Chen Ji's voice was cold as frost: You knelt yourself. He walked past the gatekeeper without looking back: In the Celestial Realm, how many like you exist? The gatekeeper knelt on the ground, body trembling, not daring the slightest thought of resistance. Only when Chen Ji's figure disappeared into the depths of the Divine Palace did he dare raise his head, eyes filled with the joy of surviving and deep-seated resentment. You wait... he hissed: The Celestial Realm won't forgive you... The other guards on the jade steps looked at each other in bewilderment, and no one dared obstruct Chen Ji's path.

text.content: However, the moment Chen Ji stepped through the Divine Palace gates, a strange agitation suddenly surged in his heart. The Tianji Record Fragment shook violently in his Mental Sea, countless blurred images flickering like a carousel— that gaze hidden in the depths of the Void seemed to have grown even more intense. The gatekeeper's departing words coiled around Chen Ji's heart like venomous serpents— 'The laws of the Celestial Realm exist only for those of the Celestial Realm. You, after all, are merely an ant that strayed into the immortal realm.' And now, that gaze hidden in the depths of the Void seemed to have grown even more intense... Chen Ji's steps paused slightly, his eyes flashing with sharp light. He didn't look back, merely letting a faint smile curve his lips. The Celestial Realm's laws? Ants? He'd like to see what the Celestial Realm could do when this ant turned the world upside down.

Inside the Divine Palace, everything was resplendent and magnificent, with immortal mists swirling. Dao Law forces intertwined into a web, adorning this space like a true immortal realm. Yet beneath this prosperity, Chen Ji caught an unusual scent. Too quiet. He grew vigilant internally, the Tianji Record Fragment operating frantically to seize those killing moves hidden in the shadows. At this moment, a figure stepped out from the Void, surrounded by pale golden Dao Law power— it was indeed that gatekeeper. His features were hidden within the halo of light, only those eyes remaining, cold as if surveying ants. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his voice平静得不带一丝波澜: What does this mean? The gatekeeper sneered, a hint of mockery surfacing in the golden halo: I guard this place by order of the Celestial Realm— you cannot simply walk in. Rules are rules— to pass through this gate, you must pay the toll. The resources of the Celestial Realm are not something common mortals should covet?

dialogue.content: Toll? Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, as if hearing some enormous joke. His gaze fell upon the gatekeeper, eyes flashing. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, countless images flickering past like a carousel— the gatekeeper's cultivation, divine powers, magical treasures, and... the greed and fear hidden beneath that golden halo. Dare to act so presumptuously before me! The gatekeeper bellowed in rage, Dao Law forces erupting around him. An invisible pressure like a mountain range bore down toward Chen Ji. Do you know what great sin it is to insult a gatekeeper of the Celestial Realm? His voice was ice-cold: Today, I shall teach you the depth of the heavens! On the jade steps, the winds and clouds changed color. Golden Dao Law forces transformed into countless chains, sweeping toward Chen Ji. Spectators changed expressions— that was a sealing technique unique to the Celestial Realm. Once bound, even one with unfathomable cultivation would have to submit.

text.content: Yet there was not a trace of fear on Chen Ji's face. His right hand slowly rose, and within his palm, a wisp of chaotic-colored airflow began to coalesce. Though slender, that airflow emanated a terrifying might— a power surpassing the laws of the Celestial Realm. This was... the aura of the Quasi-Heavenly Dao Stage! The gatekeeper's pupils constricted sharply, all arrogance gone from his face, replaced by incomprehensible fear: Impossible! You're merely an ant that ascended from the lower realm— how could you possess such power? Chen Ji stepped forward, the chaotic airflow surging violently: Who told you I was an ant? On the jade steps, the winds and clouds changed color. The golden halo around the gatekeeper trembled violently, that Quasi-Heavenly Dao pressure pressing down as tangibly as solid matter, causing his knees to bend involuntarily. He... Heavenly Dao Laws? His voice trembled, eyes filled with terror:

}},{\"dialogue.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. He merely raised his hand and flicked gently. That wisp of chaotic airflow transformed into a dazzling rainbow, instantly piercing the gatekeeper's protective golden light. The gatekeeper let out a miserable shriek,身形暴退数百丈，mouth vomiting blood profusely. You... The gatekeeper clutched his heavily wounded chest, eyes filled with resentment and fear: The Celestial Realm won't forgive you... Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing down at the fallen gatekeeper, a faint, detached smile curving his lips: The Celestial Realm? His voice echoed across the empty jade steps: I'd like to see just how formidable the dignity of the Celestial Realm truly is. He turned and walked toward the depths of the Divine Palace, his silhouette lonely and resolute. Spectators dared not breathe, none daring to obstruct his path.

text.content: However, the moment Chen Ji stepped through the Divine Palace gates, the unexpected occurred. As the gatekeeper fell, an even more powerful aura suddenly erupted from deep within the Divine Palace. That aura was vast as an abyss, carrying a suffocating oppression, like a primordial beast that slumbered for ten thousand years slowly opening its eyes. Chen Ji's steps halted abruptly, eyes flashing sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea convulsed wildly, countless blurred images flooding his consciousness— it was a figure, hidden within endless immortal fog, features invisible, yet one could sense the coldness and pressure contained within those eyes. Here it comes. He murmured softly, yet there was not a trace of fear in his voice: Good, let me see what other experts the Celestial Realm still conceals. That figure slowly emerged from the immortal fog, surrounded by nine golden Dao Law halos, each representing a supreme Celestial Realm law. Quasi-Heavenly Dao Peak. His aura was unmistakably Quasi-Heavenly Dao Peak! Compared to the gatekeeper from before, he was who knows how many times stronger.

dialogue.content: Interesting. The new gatekeeper spoke, his voice like great bells resonating, causing the entire Divine Palace to tremble: A lower-realm ascender who could defeat a Celestial Realm gatekeeper at the Quasi-Heavenly Dao Stage. He walked forward slowly, each step making space itself shudder: You're interesting, but that's all. The dignity of the Celestial Realm brooks no desecration. His right hand rose, the nine Dao Law halos instantly transforming into a towering golden great sword, slashing down toward Chen Ji. Yet facing this sword, Chen Ji smiled. That smile carried a hint of playfulness, a hint of disdain, and even a hint of... anticipation? Finally, a worthy opponent. His voice echoed within the sword's light: Let me see whether the Celestial Realm's laws can withstand this strike of mine! His right hand rose once more, chaotic-colored airflow beginning to condense madly within his palm.

text.content: BOOM—! The two forces collided violently in mid-air, golden and chaotic-colored light intertwining, illuminating the entire Divine Palace as bright as day. Violent energy aftershocks spread in all directions, jade steps cracking, immortal fog dispersing, spectators scrambling backward. After a moment, the light faded, revealing two opposing figures. The gatekeeper's golden great sword had shattered, while Chen Ji still stood with hands clasped behind his back, as if that strike had been merely effortless for him. Impossible! The gatekeeper's pupils constricted sharply, face full of disbelief: You only just stepped into the Quasi-Heavenly Dao Stage— how could you possess such power? Chen Ji offered no answer. His gaze越过守门者，落在了神殿深处那道隐藏在虚空中的注视上。他能感觉到，那道注视的主人，正在评估着他的价值。有趣。他在心中暗道：天界之主吗？还是说……那位传说中的天道之眼？

choice.prompt: The oppressive pressure emanating from the depths of the Divine Palace grew increasingly intense. That existence hidden within the Void appeared to be evaluating your worth. How will you respond?

choices.description: Ignore all probing and directly challenge that existence, proving your worth through absolute strength.
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the entire assembly, reputation soaring
choices.process_label: 你决定不再隐藏，以最强姿态迎战

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. His toes tapped the ground, his form shooting toward the depths of the Divine Palace like lightning. The gatekeeper cried out in alarm, hastily moving to intercept, yet Chen Ji sent him flying with a single palm. Just as he was about to reach the source of that gaze, a sky-blocking giant hand emerged from the Void, slamming down ruthlessly toward him. That hand was so vast it encompassed heaven and earth; its pressure so intense it could destroy an entire minor world. Yet Chen Ji showed not a hint of fear. Chaotic airflow surged violently around him, transforming into a towering great sword that狠狠斩向那遮天巨手。

dialogue.content: BOOM—! The great sword and giant hand collided violently in mid-air, causing the entire Divine Palace to shake violently, as if it might collapse at any moment. After a brief instant, that sky-blocking giant hand was cleaved in two by the great sword, dissolving into countless law fragments scattered across the Void. The terror of a single strike's might! Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back in the Void, robes fluttering, eyes blazing: Who else? His voice echoed through the empty Divine Palace, carrying indomitable majesty. That existence hidden within the Void remained silent for a moment, then emitted a low laugh: Interesting... very interesting... You've successfully captured my interest.

choices.description: Temporarily retreat, gather strength in secret, awaiting the optimal moment to strike again.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength for a future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: May be underestimated by the opponent
choices.process_label: 你决定先保存实力，不与对方硬碰硬

text.content: Facing that sky-blocking giant hand, Chen Ji did not choose to confront it directly. His toes tapped the ground, body暴退千丈，barely dodging that world-destroying strike. Oh? The existence in the Void seemed somewhat surprised: Daring to retreat? Chen Ji stood in the distance, expression calm: Your strength is unfathomable, I admit I am no match. His voice was neither servile nor overbearing: May I ask your esteemed name, so I might know under whose hand I fell today.

dialogue.content: The presence fell silent for a moment, then let out a disdainful laugh: Your withdrawal without fighting is a wise choice. This One's name is... Tianxu. Tianxu? Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he quickly calculated in his heart. Tianxu, the chief of the Heavenly Pole Stars of the Big Dipper, one of the legendary supreme enforcers of heavenly laws. This title, he had seen records of in the Tianji Record Fragment. As expected, a great figure of the Heavenly Realm. He clasped his hands and said: This one is Chen Ji, having caused much offense today, I hope the senior shows magnanimity. Tianxu's laugh carried a hint of playfulness: Magnanimity? You defeated the gatekeeper of the Heavenly Realm and severed a thread of this One's divine sense, yet you wish for this One's magnanimity? However... you are interesting. This One gives you a chance.

choices.description: Not confronting with force, but with wisdom. Using words to probe the opponent's bottom line, seeking weaknesses and exploitable points.
choices.risk_hint: May Be Perceived by the Opponent
choices.process_label: 你决定以言语试探，寻找对方的弱点

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat, but stepped forward, his gaze fixed on the hidden presence: The honored one just said that the laws of the Heavenly Realm are only for those of the Heavenly Realm. His voice was calm: Then may I ask, can this one also become a person of the Heavenly Realm? The presence in the void seemed unprepared for such a question, and after a moment of silence said: You wish to join the Heavenly Realm? Chen Ji nodded: The strong rule, the fit survive. This is the iron law of the cultivation world. Since the honored one guards this place, surely you have seen countless mighty ones who wished to ascend to the Heavenly Realm. Among them, there is no lack of prodigious talents.

dialogue.content: He continued: This one is unworthy, but is willing to use this as a stepping stone in exchange for an opportunity. His words carried hidden barbs—if the other party agreed, it would acknowledge his value; if they refused, he could seize the opportunity to probe the opponent's bottom line. The presence fell silent for a long while, then let out a low chuckle: You are clever, more clever than any lower-realm person this One has ever met. Unfortunately... the rules of the Heavenly Realm are not as you imagine. His voice carried a hint of deeper meaning: This One can tell you a secret—about the secret of the Tianji Record. Do you, wish to know? Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, alarm bells ringing in his heart. The other party actually knew of the Tianji Record's existence?

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but in his heart, monstrous waves were already churning. The Tianji Record was his greatest secret, the foundation of his dominance across the world, yet the other party actually knew about it? His mind raced, countless thoughts flickering like lightning. Tianxu... Tianji Record... what connection lies between these two? He took a deep breath, suppressed the shock in his heart, revealing nothing on his face: Oh? I eagerly await the details. The presence seemed quite satisfied with his reaction, its laughter growing even lower: This One can tell you the origin of the Tianji Record, and... who its true master is. But the condition is—you must do one thing for this One. What thing? Chen Ji asked, his voice so calm that not even a trace of turmoil could be detected. Very simple. The presence's voice carried a hint of temptation: Kill a person.

Chen Ji's eyes flickered, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea went into frantic tremors, and countless images surged toward his consciousness—those were memory fragments about Tianxu, about the operational principles of Heavenly Realm laws, about... that presence. After a moment, he spoke: Who should I kill? Tianxu's voice carried a hint of playfulness: Your old friend—Ling Yuan. The old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, but his face remained unmoved: Though Ling Yuan and I have our disagreements, he is nonetheless a fellow sect member. Killing him, what benefit would I gain? Benefit? Tianxu's laughter grew even lower: This One can tell you how to completely repair the Tianji Record, making it a true treasure of Heavenly Dao. And Ling Yuan is precisely one of the key figures blocking you from repairing the Tianji Record. So, is this deal worthwhile? Chen Ji fell silent. Ling Yuan—that old Sect Master who superficially sheltered him but harbored hidden malice. He knew the other party was dangerous, but never imagined they were dangerous enough that even a Heavenly Realm being wanted them eliminated.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before speaking: I need time to consider. Tianxu did not seem surprised by his answer: Very well. But this One does not have much patience. His voice carried a warning: Within three days, this One wants an answer. Otherwise... you will know what it means to make an enemy of the Heavenly Realm. The words fell, and that vast, abyss-like pressure suddenly dissipated, as if it had never existed. Chen Ji stood alone in the depths of the temple, his gaze deep and profound, lost in thought. Three days... he silently repeated in his heart: the truth of the Tianji Record, Ling Yuan's secrets, and the Heavenly Realm's conspiracy... this game of chess grows ever more interesting. The corner of his mouth slightly lifted, forming a meaningful arc. Tianxu, you wish to make me a chess piece? Then let's see, in the end, who is the chess piece, and who is the Chess Player.

text.content: The moment the gatekeeper fell, a mightier aura came from the distance. That aura was vast as an abyss, carrying a heart-trembling oppression, as if a slumbering primordial beast was slowly opening its eyes—the next chapter, Chen Ji will face true trials. Yet just as that aura approached, Chen Ji sensed a certain familiar presence—a fluctuation unique to the Tianji Record Fragment, creating a resonance with the Tianji Record within him. It's here. He murmured, his eyes flashing brilliantly. He knew, the fortune he had long awaited, was finally arriving. Who was the master of that aura? Friend or foe? And what did the resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and that aura signify? All answers would be revealed in the next moment.
